title: Tenet
scope: The 2020 film · the two sides of the Oslo encounter
premise: At Oslo, the Protagonist fights a masked figure. Returning to that encounter reveals why both sides looked so strange.
ending: The masked opponent was the Protagonist himself, travelling through the encounter while inverted. The later visit supplies the other participant in the fight already shown; this guide makes no claim to explain every operation in the film.

people.name: The Protagonist
people.introduction: The same person encountering an earlier stage of his own life.

events.title: He enters the Oslo freeport
events.text: The Protagonist and Neil enter the freeport while a staged plane crash provides cover. They find a turnstile whose function they do not yet understand.

events.title: He fights someone moving strangely
events.text: A masked opponent emerges at the turnstile. The fight looks physically wrong because the two participants are moving in opposite temporal directions.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · the forward side of the encounter

events.title: Later, he becomes inverted
events.text: After the events in Tallinn, the Protagonist joins an inverted journey back toward the earlier Oslo operation. He now needs the freeport’s turnstile.
events.whenLabel: Tallinn · later by the ordinary calendar

events.title: He reaches Oslo from the other direction
events.text: The inverted Protagonist reaches the freeport around the plane crash. His route brings him into the same encounter that he previously experienced from the other side.

events.title: He is the masked opponent
events.text: He fights his earlier, uninverted self. The two appearances belong to one person at different points in his experienced life.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · the inverted side of the same encounter

events.title: The turnstile lets him move forward again
events.text: He passes through the turnstile and leaves in the ordinary temporal direction. The apparent mystery opponent now has a place in his own journey.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · after his passage through the turnstile

sources.title: Repository story record
sources.note: Editorial pilot adapted from the repository. Scene wording and interpretation await a separate review against the primary work.

connections.label: While inverted, he travels from the later Tallinn events back toward Oslo.

rows.subject: The masked figure
rows.beforeText: An unknown opponent with puzzling movements.
rows.afterText: The Protagonist at a later stage of his own journey, while inverted.
